reviews.text: Cindy has went above and beyond to help us…twice!   We purchased a tarp for our cattle trailer 2+ years ago and it was a smooth and easy process the first time we worked with Cindy.   Fast forward to today….we just got around to putting our tarp on the cattle trailer.   We had some installation questions and I thought I would call back to see if they could help again.  I was right, I worked with Cindy again and she was a great help walking us through the process.   Thank so much Cindy!!

Cindy Foxx did a great job going back and forth with us exchanging ideas and helping us understand the custom tarp fabrication process until we arrived at a highly effective solution.  We used out new custom tarp (rain fly) at a camp out last weekend.  There were fairly high winds and this stout, well made tarp barely even moved or fluttered.  We definitely recommend this business to others.
reviews.author: William Leonhardt

reviews.text: Cindy Foxx was so easy to work with, We greatly appreciated her time and energy especially since we showed up right near closing hours!
reviews.author: Audrey

reviews.text: The Sales and Administrative Staff were very professional and very nice.  The Installers were also Professional and courteous. Everything went smoothly and as planned.
reviews.author: Dan Andrus

reviews.text: We wanted to add an awning to protect a 2nd parking spot at our old house. John Weaver, Kevin  & Cindy were all great to work with in trying to create something that would fit with the age and style of our home. They were efficient and the finished product turned out better than I'd hoped. I highly recommend them for awnings.
reviews.author: Russ W

reviews.text: We have had our ACF drop down tarps for 7 years.  Many outdoor activities and family gatherings are made more comfortable on the deck with these drop down tarps.  The deck shifted away from the house and caused some damage to the tarps.  ACF adjusted the existing tarps and repaired the damage.  They are a good product and ACF has a customer for life in our family.
reviews.author: William Wilson

reviews.text: We are incredibly grateful to have found ACF Tarp & Awning. Our playground tarps at Lake Houston UMC were in bad shape. Ask for Cindy, she was so kind and helpful. We received our tarps quickly, they are perfect in color and exactly what we hoped for. Thank you!!!
reviews.author: Christen Thibodeaux

reviews.text: Dan and Kerri  We appreciate the great job you guys did installing our awnings!They look wonderful ,fit the frames tight and the seams match.. FANTASTIC!
reviews.author: Wanda Atken

reviews.text: Cindy Foxx is the best, very helpful. Tarps are heavy duty, and great quality!!! Thank you much ACY
reviews.author: Enrico Collins

reviews.text: This is the highest quality covering I have ever had. I sent in the dimensions and promptly received it back with a perfect fit. I have sprinklers that go off in my back yard and we have had extremely high winds these last few weeks and my grill is dry and the covering hasn’t moved. It more than adequately covers my grill and exceeded my expectations in every way. 5 stars!
reviews.author: Caroline Cowan VanDevender

reviews.text: I ordered covers for wagons we had made and they were very helpful and quick to get our order made. I would recommend them!
reviews.author: Keri Kirby

reviews.text: Cindy Foxx was fast and efficient and ACF's work is great with amazing prices!
reviews.author: David Deison

reviews.text: I could not be more happy with the service I received from ACF Tarp & Awning. After having had difficulties with another company being unable to follow through, Andy Chitwood came and saved the day. They finished the job in the time period promised, and the results are very satisfactory. The installation crew of Salvador, Salvador, and Jose could not be more efficient and competent—and pleasant to work with! I do not know the names of the people who did the sewing and painting of the frames, but I so appreciate their good work, as well as the courtesy of Cindy who was always available to answer my questions and check on the progress. I recommend ACF without reservation!
reviews.author: Bonnie Creel

reviews.text:
AXF Tarp and awning is very good at what they do. There’s a reason they have been around since 1979. Years ago they made a custom tarp/cover for my trailer and it fit like a glove. Recently they fabricated some custom shade cloths for a greenhouse attached to a historic home Dallas

I highly recommend ACF!!
reviews.author: David Heimerman

reviews.text: Cindy is amazing. Went above and beyond to accommodate us! Thank you so much!
reviews.author: Colt Williams

reviews.text: Terry and his partner did a bang up job getting new anchors and getting my cover put on.

reviews.text: Dan and Kerri hung my new awning today and did a beautiful job! It was done to perfection.
reviews.author: Susan Blackmon

reviews.text: Great experience with Cindy and the staff at ACF Tarp & Awning.  CIndy provided a firm quote and produced a custom cover for the control panel on our bucket truck.  The cover fit like a glove, and secured as intended. I highly recommend the services of ACF Tarp and Awning!
reviews.author: Howard Sanders

reviews.text: I used ACF to replace a very large awning at one of my managed properties in DFW area.  From the first call, customer service was awesome!  We had some unique issues to work through with this install. Selection of colors and proper materials for this application were tricky, but ACF provided the needed guidance and they were very sensitive to the needs of our client.  I appreciated the expertise of John and enjoyed working with his team. I would highly recommend their services.
reviews.author: DK L

reviews.text: The team at ACF Tarp and Awning did a great job from start to finish on our pool cover. They always communicated the status to us during the build process and Travis and James did a excellent job on the install. I highly recommended them.
reviews.author: Chris C

reviews.text:
These people are the best so helpful I went for a repair on a bimini top a d they fixed luckily split.
HIGHLY Recommend.
reviews.author: Renee Sanderson

reviews.text: We installed a 7 ft. stock  tank swimming pool, and I called ACF to order a pool cover.  Cindy was friendly and helpful from the start!  I explained what I needed, provided the needed dimensions and purpose, and ACF designed just what we needed.  The tarp covers the pool perfectly, and the skirting as grommets allowing for the tie down rope.  We are extremely happy with ACF and the results.  Definitely recommend.
reviews.author: Steve Ann

reviews.text: Wonderful company! We have used for various projects from marching band props, customizing boat cover, greenhouse tarp repairs & recently, enclosure for outdoor room. If you think something can't be made or fixed, call them!!! John & entire staff are great!!!
reviews.author: Renee M

reviews.text:
We moved in to our house in 2002 and ACF has done 2 sets of awnings for us. They have been extremely easy to work with and they maintain a high level of professionalism. We have made several custom requests and they are always able to fulfill them. I took the awnings down to paint the house and they came back out and reassembled them at our convenience. We highly recommend this company.

Bill Bowman and Kris Lewis
reviews.author: Kristine Lewis

reviews.text: Called a few companies and ACF was the only one that got back to me. I sent them a picture of my awning and what pattern I wanted for the new one and I had a quote the next day. It took eight days from start to finish to have them come to my house remove the existing awning and replace it with a new one. Kevin and Cindy did a great job. HIGHLY recommend
reviews.author: Don Evon

reviews.text:
Best service and quality in Texas.
Installed a pool cover and it is great.
My pool man was so impressed he asked for their number for his other clients.
Great people to work with and quality and service can not be be any better. Price is great also.
If you need any tarp or awning work these are the people to call.
reviews.author: Raymond Moore

reviews.text:
Travis and his partner were very polite...very meticulously and did a great job installing my pool cover.   They were fast and efficient and cleaned the work area when they completed their job task.
Thanks for having these types of employees
Austin Prescott
reviews.author: Austin Prescott

reviews.text: We had a beautiful black awning made to go over our front door!! With scalloped trim! It looks so fabulous! John Weaver took our order and Travis Lovett and his helper installed it! They did a great job!! Travis even fixed our wrought iron gate!! Thank you so much!!
reviews.author: Carol Horrocks

reviews.text: We have used ACF Tarp and Awning for our tarp needs for the last 4 years and the quality of the material and craftsmanship is top notch. The customer service they provide us via over the phone and in person is always refreshing. Not many companies these days treat people with the respect and dignity that I see in ACF. We consider ACF a lifelong partner in our trucking business and we know they feel the same toward us.
reviews.author: Ryan Koons

reviews.text: Hands down 10 out of 10! John got us all setup with everything which was great. James Lovett executed the installation seamlessly! He was very professional, quick, and super friendly. If you are looking for awning and tarp installation do not even hesitate ACF should be your choice! 😎
reviews.author: MJ

reviews.text:
What a great experience we had working with ACF Tarp & Awning on awnings for the front of our house!
From the appointment we had with Kevin Mc Intosh to design the awnings, to Cindy in the office, & finally
installation by Travis Lovett and his crew—— all handled in a friendly, professional way.
Plus, the price for our awnings from ACF was the best of several estimates we got!
We would certainly recommend them to others!
reviews.author: Linda Ambrose

reviews.text: I had a great experience getting a boat cover made by ACF. They are very kind people who do quick, high quality work. Thank you for helping install our broken taillight as well. Go Texans!
reviews.author: Lauren Geis

reviews.text: We couldn’t be happier with the outcome of our project! Also they are all Very professional and courteous. Travis and his crew does an amazing job! Already have another job in the works because would not use anyone else! Highly recommended!
reviews.author: Tonya Dodson

reviews.text: ACF Tarp and Awning constructed beautiful awnings for our home to help reduce the heat and glare of the hot Texas sun. The planning process including the in-home consultation was easy and with the huge selection of quality fabrics we found the perfect accents for our home.  The installation team was very professional and thorough. So pleased we hired ACF!
reviews.author: Kristin Henderson

reviews.text: ACF Tarp & Awning provided the quickest and most professional service you can find. We Needed a quick turn around on a Tarp for Chimy's Cerveceria. Not only did they do the job, but the final product was even better than we could have asked for! Job big or small, ACF has provided for all our needs! Would highly recommend these kind people.
reviews.author: bailey rector

reviews.text: I cannot say enough good things about the crew at ACF Tarp & Awning.  As a small business owner I was concerned about the cost of a custom built awning.  But the prices are reasonable and the quality is outstanding.  I now have colorful awnings outside each of my three stores within the Metroplex! John was amazing to work with.Thanks ACF Tarp & Awning.
reviews.author: Elizabeth Hart

reviews.text:
Needed help getting a custom tarp.  Cindy was awesome and very helpful.  Went above and beyond.
UPDATE TO MY REVIEW.  UPS lost my shipment and again, ACF stepped up and made it right.  If I ever need a tarp, these are the people I am going to contact.  Great customer service, well and beyond good.
reviews.author: Dave Rains

reviews.text: James and Josh were very honest and helpful. They installed a large awning over my backyard patio.  The work was done correctly and, James and Mike worked in a timely manner. I would use JameS and Josh for all of my awning jobs all over my house. Do the right thing, and hire James and Josh. You will be very glad that you hired them
reviews.author: Meg Davis

reviews.text: Incredible job with our custom awning project in our backyard!!! From start to finish, ACF went above and beyond. Would highly recommend for any tarp or awning needs.
reviews.author: George LeBus

reviews.text: Love the privacy tarp your guys brought out! James and his crew were very professional and friendly :-)
reviews.author: Julie French

reviews.text:

I would absolutely recommend them to anyone.
Thanks again,
John

reviews.text: Our pool cover was installed by Travis Lovett.  He was very professional and did a great job.  We love the cover and Travis was so good at explaining the access hatch.

we bought our very large tarp for our martial arts studio Mats in 1996...My instructor also purchased the tarp from ACF in 1974  that I trained on as a teenager... they are virtually indestructible!!👊🏼

reviews.text: This is the most awesome tarp company!  They have been to my home twice and have done an outstanding job.  One thing is for sure, they love their country and really take care of our country's veterans.

reviews.text: Highly recommend! All our awnings are from ACF! We even had a bad storm that caused a tree to fall and knock our awning right off the house and ACF was there ASAP to get put back up and looking good as new!

reviews.text: ACF helped us out of a jam.  Cindy Foxx worked with us quickly and cheerfully to produce a quality product for our customer.  I highly recommend ACF Tarp & Awning.

!Extremely pleased with their work!
